race.title: Gerry Comerford Drilling Beginners Chase
race.verdict: This could go to one of the chasing debutants, with PRINCESS AVEEN preferred after showing sound form in points and winning over hurdles at Fairyhouse in October. Clody Diamond is open to improvement on her second start in this discipline so is on the shortlist along with Market Ready . PRINCESS AVEEN (IRE) CLODY DIAMOND (IRE) MARKET READY (IRE)
